name: nothread
description: Single-hart replacements for musl's locking and thread primitives

objects.note: Single-hart replacements for musl's locking, waiting and thread primitives: a lock is a no-op that succeeds, and a call that blocks ends the guest, because nothing can wake it. The guest has one hart and no threads, and this module says so explicitly. This works by definition, not by --wrap: a wrap would leave musl's members in the image. So the object must precede libc.a: the linker takes an archive member only for a symbol that is still undefined. Only platforms with the no-atomics flag link it; the others keep musl's primitives, which are also correct on one hart.
